full_prompt_en: A square surreal painting shows a broad staircase rising through a huge circular opening in a stone wall toward an empty ochre landscape. The round portal fills almost the entire frame, its dark rim set into weathered beige masonry marked with small cracks and uneven blocks. At the bottom center, shallow steps spread toward the viewer in a wide fan before narrowing as they climb. Two railings then split away to the left and right along the circle, making the architecture both orderly and improbable. A tall figure in a long dark coat walks up near the upper center, seen from behind. Several steps below, a smaller figure in a vivid red coat follows along the middle line. The two provide scale to the immense opening and a bright focus within the subdued environment. Inside the lower sides of the circle, shadowed built spaces contain dark wood panels, a small warm lamp, and a round wall detail on the right. Beyond the stair landing, pale brown grasslands stretch under a layered gray-blue sky. A low red-brown building sits slightly left of center in the distance, behind a rough dark strip of ground. The scene is rendered with controlled fine grain and carefully aligned steps, while the distant field remains soft and empty. Muted olive, stone gray, tobacco brown, and ochre dominate, making the little red coat striking. Cool daylight enters from the distant sky, brightening the outer field and the upper stair treads, while weak amber lamps touch the inner walls and lower corners stay in shade. The overall composition centers the ascent inside a giant circular frame, joining precise symmetry, quiet emptiness, and one intense color note.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形超现实绘画描绘一道宽阔阶梯，穿过石墙上的巨大圆形开口，升向空旷的赭色风景。圆门几乎填满全幅，深色边缘嵌入风化的米色砌体，墙面有细裂缝和不均匀石块。底部中央，浅台阶向观者扇形展开，向上时逐渐收窄。两道栏杆随后沿圆洞分别向左右岔开，使建筑既有秩序又不合常理。一位穿深色长外套的高个子人物在上方中央附近背向观者登阶。再下几级，一位穿鲜明红外套的较小人物沿中线跟随。两人为巨大开口提供尺度，并在低调环境中形成亮点。圆洞下部两侧，阴暗的建筑空间里有深木板、小暖灯，右侧还有圆形墙饰。阶梯尽头之外，浅褐草地一直伸展到层叠灰蓝天空下。远处中央略偏左有一栋低矮红褐建筑，后面是一道粗糙深色地带。场景以受控细颗粒和仔细对齐的台阶呈现，远田野则柔和空寂。低饱和橄榄、石灰、烟草褐和赭黄占主导，使小小红外套格外突出。冷日光从远处天空进入，照亮外面田地和较高阶面，微弱琥珀灯光触及内墙，下方角落留在阴影中。整体构图把上升的路径置于巨大圆框中，结合精确对称、安静空旷和一个强烈色彩音符。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely grained surreal painted finish, with exact architectural geometry set against softly open distance. Muted stone, ochre, olive, and brown build a low-contrast field, interrupted by a small saturated accent. Strong circular and converging lines organize the composition, while minute weathering marks prevent the surfaces from looking mechanical. The largest forms are symmetrical and still; tiny off-center details supply scale and tension. Cool diffuse light opens the distant area, and isolated warm points remain within deeper interior shade. Edges stay firm on the main structure but soften toward the horizon. The overall effect is contemplative and uncanny, where precise spatial order leads into quiet visual uncertainty.
style_prompt_zh: 图像有细颗粒的超现实绘画完成面，精确建筑几何对照柔和开放的远景。低饱和石色、赭黄、橄榄和褐色建立低反差色域，被一个小而饱和的重音打断。强烈圆形与汇聚线条组织构图，微小风化痕迹让表面不显机械。最大形体对称而静止，偏离中心的细节提供尺度和张力。冷漫射光打开远处空间，孤立暖光点留在更深室内阴影中。主要结构边缘明确，向地平线则柔化。整体效果沉思而诡异，精确空间秩序导向安静的视觉不确定性。
theme_en: Two figures climb a staircase through a vast round opening toward a barren field
theme_zh: 两个人沿台阶走向巨大圆洞外的荒凉田野
name: Mike Worrall
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
